checks.finding: Grep across research/firstbattle/** and glob across /root/lingxi for calendar/holiday/DST/early_close/session_calendar found zero locally frozen trading-calendar artifact for any equity market. FAB-MSV2-01's claim 'PIT 最强（提前数年已知）' is true IN PRINCIPLE for public exchange calendars but is NOT YET a locally constructed, hash-bound, versioned artifact; none currently exists in this repository.

Directory listing of records/history/okx_1h/*.jsonl shows the tokenized-perp universe spans far more than one calendar: US common stocks/ETFs (AAPL, TSLA, SPY, QQQ, IWM, most of the 401), country ETFs on FOREIGN calendars (EWJ=Japan/TSE, EWT=Taiwan, EWY=Korea/KRX, EWZ=Brazil), foreign single-name perps on their own exchanges (SAMSUNG, SONY, SOFTBANK, HYUNDAI, SKHYNIX, ASML, TSEM), commodities with no clean single daily 'closed' session (XAU, XAG, XCU, XPD, XPT), and private-company perps with NO underlying public market at all (OPENAI, ANTHROPIC, MINIMAX, ZHIPU — already correctly excluded by Fable). FAB-MSV2-01's '121 symbols share one shock' framing understates the problem: even after Fable's own day-clustering correction (effective independent samples ≈ trading-day count, not event count), the 121 are not even ONE shared calendar-shock cluster; they are several DISTINCT calendar clusters (US majority + several small foreign clusters + a commodity sub-group with an ill-defined session boundary). Pooling all 121 into one denominator without stratification would silently inflate apparent independence across sub-clusters that do not share a holiday/DST calendar.
checks.consequence: Any shortlisted version of this mechanism must be rescoped to a SINGLE, calendar-verified sub-universe (this reviewer recommends: US-listed common stock/ETF tickers on the NYSE/NASDAQ calendar only) rather than the full undifferentiated 121, until per-market calendars are separately constructed and verified for the other clusters.

decision_journal.problem_restatement: Independently restate, dedup/cluster, and outcome-blind score all 19 candidates from three independently-produced owner files, using only feature-side existing-history metadata, then freeze a Mechanism Hypothesis Library before any shortlist selection.
competing_hypotheses: HA: owners' own DATA_BLIND/REJECTED self-labels are trustworthy and this reviewer can rubber-stamp them.
HB: owners' self-labels must be independently re-derived from raw local artifacts, not trusted, per task instruction to not trust owner self-scoring.
HC: at least one candidate clears the shortlist bar on existing history without further acquisition.
HD: zero candidates clear the bar and the honest answer is to return to mechanism research.
decision_journal.chosen_method: Re-verified file existence/schema/counts directly against records/history/** (R1-R6, R9-R11), cross-referenced the three owner files against each other for contradictions neither owner could see alone (R7, R8), re-computed self-excluding hashes for all bound inputs, and independently confirmed the Fable owner corrected its self-hash to the reviewer's prior recomputed value without changing canonical mechanism content. Applied the frozen 8-item hard-reject screen and the frozen 5-weight rubric with reviewer-assigned (not owner-assigned) scores, and clustered all 19 by real payer/clock/denominator overlap rather than trusting each owner's own non_isomorphism_proof at face value.
decision_journal.strongest_own_counterexample: FAB-MSV2-01's rescoped clearance of the shortlist bar rests on two things this reviewer did NOT fully verify: (1) OKX's actual index/mark computation methodology during underlying-market-closed windows (public docs, not yet located/hash-bound), and (2) feature separability between boundary and non-boundary bars (not yet computed). Both remain open falsification cuts; this reviewer's positive weekend-price-movement check (R3) is necessary-not-sufficient and should not be read as a full pass.
decision_journal.most_likely_ignored_blind_spot: This reviewer's own re-scoping of FAB-01 to a US-listed-only calendar cluster is itself an unverified design choice made under time constraints; it has not been checked for whether even the US-only subset genuinely reaches 20 independent trading days once holidays/early-closes are properly excluded (only a plausibility argument, not a computed count), and the exact US-only subset (vs. tokenized ETFs like TQQQ/SOXL/UVXY that track baskets, not single issuers) is not yet enumerated.
decision_journal.budget_spent: Read-only review of 3 candidate files, 6 upstream frozen/registry files, history_catalog.json (grepped, not fully read given 1.3MB size), FIRST_BATTLE_MASTER_PLAN.md (grepped section only), plus direct feature-side sampling of records/history/okx_1h and records/history/okx_funding (price/funding-rate/timestamp fields only) and one temporary/deleted Go hash-verification program under cmd/. No downloads, no purchases, no outcome reads, no commits.
decision_journal.stop_decision: Library frozen; proceeds to mechanism_shortlist.json and mechanism_shortlist_reviewer_receipt.json in the same delivery, then stops for user approval. Does not proceed to data contract freezing, generation preregistration, or any acquisition beyond what is already local.
